cand.title: Les Hivernales 2027
cand.excerpt: Verified organized demand is valuable, but committed venue and absent lodging data reduce current accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified 2026 organizer contacts, not verified contract signatories: Zeyna Erdemoglu, communication lead, a routing contact for committee/partnership introductions; Julien Schindler, one of the programmers, relevant for identifying artist-production/hospitality requirements. Their 2027 responsibilities and hotel purchasing authority require confirmation. Public entry: info@leshivernales.ch or organizer contact form; the form excludes programming enquiries.
findings.futureEdition: Official organizer homepage announces the 17th edition, 4–7 March 2027, Nyon & Gland. Municipal and regional tourism pages independently publish these activity dates. Within the requested horizon. Homepage still labels its artist list “Line up 2026”; do not treat those artists as 2027 bookings. No 2028 edition dates established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: geographically relevant La Côte lodging prospect, not downtown-Geneva megashow housing. Conditional fit for a modest artist/crew cohort or individual visitors, only if paid overnight requirements and late-night transfers are demonstrated. Existing town concert venues mean no evidenced need to relocate festival performances into YOTEL’s meeting rooms. No evidence supports a 20–120-room block, whole-house use, or resort-retreat demand. YOTEL already has a generic Festivals Nyon listing, which provides a relationship channel but no Les Hivernales commitment.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 anchor: Salle communale, Rue des Marchandises 4, 1260 Nyon. Organizer practical information, beside the 4–7 March 2027 dates, lists Salle communale, L’Usine à Gaz, La Parenthèse, Fishermen’s Pub, Le Backstage Pub and La Plage. Nyon and Gland are in La Côte, Vaud, Switzerland: primary territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. Backstage Pub is identified in Gland by 2026 coverage. These are published event locations, not evidence of signed 2027 venue contracts; complete 2027 allocation remains unverified.
findings.historicalRotation: Locally anchored multi-venue festival, not a demonstrated rotating destination congress. Official history: inaugural edition 12–13 February 2010 in Nyon; Salle Communale added as a second major stage in 2011. 2025 ran 20–23 February in Nyon and surrounding venues; 2026 ran 26 February–1 March in Nyon/Gland; 2027 is announced for 4–7 March in the same two towns. Venue mix evolves; no evidence of a hotel-host rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. Organizer states: “Le festival ne dispose pas de camping mais plusieurs hôtels sont à disposition dans la région nyonnaise”. It names no hotel, block, housing bureau, booking deadline or RFP on that page. No edition-specific incumbent hotel or committed room inventory established. Shared Festivals Nyon directory entries encountered: Hôtel Le Rive, Hotel de L’Ange, Maison du Lac - Boutique Hôtel, YOTEL Geneva Lake, Ambassador Boutique Hôtel. These are generic destination listings, NOT a 2027 Les Hivernales hotel list or commitments. YOTEL’s own directory entry associates it with other named festivals but does not list Les Hivernales.
findings.organizationStructure: Association Les Hivernales, Nyon: identified as an association in Loterie Romande’s distribution report. Organizer describes a five-member year-round committee, expanded sector leads and more than 200 volunteers. OQIO describes a volunteer-run association and its creative/communication work from 2025 onward; this is not evidence OQIO is a PCO, DMC or housing buyer. No appointed accommodation agency established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced evidence of sold-out hotels, hotel overflow, lost room capacity or an exclusive incumbent. Downtown walking access is emphasized: organizer directs visitors to Nyon station and a five-minute walk. Inference: Founex lodging is less convenient for a dispersed late-night festival unless transfers are workable. Sold-out 2026 performance sessions do not demonstrate lodging compression.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach the committee via info@leshivernales.ch, asking for Zeyna Erdemoglu and the production/hospitality lead; seek an introduction to Julien Schindler if artist logistics require programming input. Confirm roles for 2027, centralized versus independent hotel booking, incumbents/exclusivity, unallocated rooms by night, budget and late-night transport. Offer a small, need-led artist/crew proposal only if requirements exist; otherwise request the next accommodation review date. Do not hold inventory or describe an RFP as open.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 event is announced; accommodation access is unknown, not open and not proven committed elsewhere. Festival venue geography is published, but neither a lodging tender nor a buyer-authorized room requirement was found. Treat as an exploratory organizer relationship, not a qualified block opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue recurring lodging-supplier consideration for artists/crew without proposing destination relocation. Historical editions establish recurrence, but do not establish 2028 dates or future accommodation procurement windows. Compete on an explicit room/transfer proposition only after confirming needs and incumbents.
